senses.sense_definition: Iets in zijn geheel opeten of opslokken.

examples.text: De woedende oceaan <w>verzwolg</w> menig schip tijdens de zware storm.

target_lang_translations.en: The raging ocean <w>swallowed</w> many a ship during the heavy storm.

examples.text: De grote brand <w>verzwolg</w> het hele bos in slechts enkele uren tijd.

target_lang_translations.en: The great fire <w>engulfed</w> the entire forest in just a few hours' time.

target_lang_definitions.en: To eat or consume something entirely, or to be engulfed by something (like a force of nature).

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To take something in so that it disappears; to consume or absorb.
To sweep over something so as to surround or cover it completely.
To eat or consume greedily or destructively.
